description:
See attached:  (1) Performance Work Statement, (2) KM Education and Experience Requirements  

  This amended announcement updates leadership requirements:  The proposed Human-Centric Knowledge Management (KM) Workforce Development Program must be led by a senior practitioner with demonstrated expertise in organizational KM, adult learning, process improvement, and Navy operational environments.  

 The Government is performing market research in order to determine if small businesses possess the capability to execute the requirements within this acquisition. Respondents need to indicate all small business designations. Interested business firms who meet the capability requirements identified in this notice are requested to reply to this notice with a response. Based upon small business responses received, consideration will be given to defining what part of the acquisition, if any, will be set-aside for small business competition. 

 Please include your business size and cage code in your submission. This is a sources sought for market research purposes. The Government’s requirement may change at any time. DO NOT submit proposals in response to this source sought. 

 SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS 

 Interested contractors are to submit the following information: company name, address, point of contact, telephone number, e-mail address; DUNS, and information regarding your company’s experience identifying: contracting agency, contract number, title, place of performance, years of performance, and value of contract per year. 
 
 Please conduct a comprehensive and detailed review of the candidate qualifications for the proposed Human-Centric Knowledge Management (KM) Workforce Development Program lead position.   Interested firms should submit a document which furnishes information describing contractor capability to meet the requirement. The submissions should be Times New Roman, font size 12 and should not exceed five (5) one-sided, 8 " X 11" pages in Microsoft Word or PDF format to the contract specialist via email to:  james.j.obbanya.civ@us.navy.mil.   Submissions must be received via email no later than 5:00 PM Pacific Standard Time on Tuesday, 1 December 2026.  Questions or comments regarding this notice shall be posted to the Contract Specialist in writing and via  EMAIL ONLY .  No phone calls will be accepted.  

 This announcement is not a contract, request for proposal, a promise to contract, or a commitment of any kind on the part of the Government. The Navy will not assume liability for costs incurred by a company for capability statement preparation or marketing efforts; therefore, any cost in response to this notice is not considered an allowable direct charge to the Government. 

 NO HARDCOPY OR FACSIMILE SUBMISSIONS WILL BE ACCEPTED. Cover letters and extraneous materials (brochures, etc.) will not be considered. Personal visits for the purpose of discussing this announcement will not be scheduled. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR A PROPOSAL.
